metadata.description: Private plugin marketplace for Extendly partner-program members. Ships Monster Meta (Facebook/Meta ad operator) and FITD Builder (niche foot-in-the-door offer builder), with more partner tools to come.

plugins.name: monster-meta
plugins.description: Monster Meta - strategic Facebook/Meta ad operator (plan, build, audit, scale) over the self-contained meta-graph MCP. Bring your own Meta token.

plugins.name: fitd-builder
plugins.description: FITD Builder - contextualize an existing menu offer to a niche (hook + story + hydrated OfferIQ pillars + ad/VSL/landing copy), or build a new offer from scratch against the OfferIQ 7-pillar standard as a submission packet.
